_comment: docs/HANDWRITING-SYNTHESIS.md §7.2 and D13: every source font, its licence and its attribution.
synth.py refuses to read a font file that is not listed here with a commercial-use licence, and
copies each entry it used into the corpus manifest, which export.py writes into the .ihwm header.
Downloaded 2026-10-14 with the user's approval. sha256 is of the file as downloaded.
Not legal advice: §7.2 asks for a proper legal read of these licences before a commercial release.

fonts._charmap_note: Each slot read off a rendered sheet of the file (docs/HANDWRITING-SYNTHESIS.md, corpus v2). The A-Z slots hold the simplex lowercase letters, which is what the set's x-height is measured on.

fonts._charmap_note: Each slot read off a rendered sheet of the file, which also carries Hershey's own glyph numbers (Delta 530, Theta 534, Omega 550, vartheta 634, lambda 637, mu 638, pi 642). Slot h is the script theta (U+03D1), not the closed theta most school notes use; corpus v2 derives its theta from Theta instead (mathglyphs.py).
